<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Ocean Simulation</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background-color: #050505; }
        canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from 'https://esm.run/three';
        import { OrbitControls } from 'https://esm.run/three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

        // Scene Setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.015);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(40, 40, 40);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(2);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.autoRotate = true;
        controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.5;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x00ffff, 1, 100);
        pointLight.position.set(0, 20, 0);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        dirLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(dirLight);

        // Voxel Ocean Configuration
        const gridSize = 60;
        const spacing = 1.1;
        const totalVoxels = gridSize * gridSize;

        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ shininess: 100 });
        const instancedMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, totalVoxels);
        scene.add(instancedMesh);

        const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
        const color = new THREE.Color();

        // Helper functions for wave generation
        function getWaveHeight(x, z, time) {
            let h = 0;
            h += Math.sin(x * 0.2 + time) * 2.0;
            h += Math.cos(z * 0.3 + time * 0.8) * 1.5;
            h += Math.sin((x + z) * 0.1 + time * 1.2) * 1.0;
            return h;
        }

        function getVoxelColor(height) {
            // Map height to colors: Deep blue -> Cyan -> White foam
            const normalized = (height + 4.5) / 9; // Approx range -4.5 to 4.5
            if (normalized < 0.3) {
                return color.setHSL(0.6, 0.8, 0.2 + normalized); // Deep Blue
            } else if (normalized < 0.7) {
                return color.setHSL(0.5, 0.9, 0.4 + (normalized - 0.3)); // Cyan/Turquoise
            } else {
                return color.setHSL(0.5, 0.2, 0.7 + (normalized - 0.7)); // Foam / White
            }
        }

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            const time = performance.now() * 0.001;
            let i = 0;

            for (let x = 0; x < gridSize; x++) {
                for (let z = 0; z < gridSize; z++) {
                    const posX = (x - gridSize / 2) * spacing;
                    const posZ = (z - gridSize / 2) * spacing;
                    
                    const height = getWaveHeight(posX, posZ, time);
                    
                    // Scale and position based on wave
                    dummy.position.set(posX, height, posZ);
                    
                    // Slightly squash and stretch voxels based on velocity/height
                    const scaleY = 1 + Math.abs(height) * 0.5;
                    dummy.scale.set(1, scaleY, 1);
                    
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    instancedMesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
                    
                    // Update color based on height
                    instancedMesh.setColorAt(i, getVoxelColor(height));

                    i++;
                }
            }

            instancedMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
            if (instancedMesh.instanceColor) instancedMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;

            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle Resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
